draft.text: You came in because you have had back pain for 2 years, which started after a fall playing basketball.
You say the pain is 7-8 out of 10 and radiates down your leg, causing numbness in your toes.
You report that injections and pain medication did not help much.
You have numbness and tingling in your toes and left leg, which feels like pins-and-needles.
You also have weakness in your left leg when standing for a long time.
Your MRI shows back issues, including disk desiccation and herniation at L4-L5, which can cause pain and numbness in your legs.
You also had one episode of bowel incontinence, which may have been due to dehydration or standing up too quickly.
We will discuss next steps to help manage your symptoms and further evaluate your condition.
